answer: An island hosts the secure enclave that signs each agent's pulse, and the beacon pays judged work only for pulses so signed; an enclave may seal one identity ever, and the seal cannot be copied or rented. Each seal burns umber, priced by the payout enclave the work remits to: the n-th chip an operator seals to one payout burns n×base umber. Its k clones thus burn base×k(k+1)/2 irrecoverably, plus one extra sealed chip for every added payout wallet. A newcomer seals at base.
